name: oracle-h
description: Safety infrastructure for autonomous AI agents. Submit critical or irreversible actions for human approval before execution. Includes anti-hallucination watchdog and reliability scoring.

tools.name: oracle_validate
tools.description: Submit a risky or irreversible action for human approval via Telegram before executing it

tools.name: oracle_poll_status
tools.description: Check if the human operator has approved or rejected a pending validation request

use_cases: Before executing destructive database commands (DROP, DELETE, TRUNCATE)
Before sending mass emails or notifications
Any action with a large blast radius or irreversible consequences
